thread:
kevin: Quick sync — vendor call today 1pm PT. Agenda: H200 firmware lag, Gaudi driver regressions, MI300 memory hotfix, marketplace embargo gating. Need SI handoff plan. Anyone with new constraints?
lina: I'm on. FYI partner said H200 FW RC slipped 48h.
sam: That 48h will impact canary region if we wait. We should plan fallback to `B200` pool for 2 days.
alex: Marketplace PM here — we need final sku mapping and embargo windows by EOD. Press wants a 2-week advance. :eyes:
emily: For SI handoff: propose checklist:
```
- run driver smoke across gaudi-staging
- validate mi300 kernel patch
- export compat matrix
- prepare canary runbook
- support rotation schedule
```
lina: +1. Also add rollback playbook for model serving fallback.
sam: Ops note: autoscale policy needs burst capacity for canary: `min=2,max=8,burst=12`
kevin: Good. Decision: call vendor now to confirm FW ETA. If >48h, we route traffic to fallback pool and open marketplace embargo for affected SKUs.
alex: Can we do an abbreviated embargo: list affected SKUs only? keeps marketing options.
emily: Yes. Draft message to partners and SI by 3pm PT. I'll handle SI docs.
release-bot: Scheduled vendor-call reminder at 12:55 PM PT
kevin: Thanks. I'll update runbook and post the embargo draft in #partnerships later. :thumbsup:
lina: tagging @sam for autoscale changes
sam: noted, will queue infra change with canary tag `canary-handoff-2026-03-23`
alex: I'll loop in comms after embargo text
emily: Uploading the checklist to the shared drive: https://drive.redwood.example/si-handbook/fw-handoff
kevin: ending thread — see you on the call.
